DrugId.description: A published native drug record identifier, without a consumer source prefix.

DrugSection.description: Explicit drug disclosures; identity cards never expand into these sections.
x-enum-descriptions: All native identity cross-references and product links, mechanically paged.
Native CIViC therapy evidence and profile context.
Native application and product history rows.
Native DDInter partner rows and levels; five rows per default page, with explicit section limits preserved. DDInter's published files carry a level per pair and no management or mechanism text.
One row per market (Drugs@FDA, EMA, WHO prequalification), each from its own source; takes a name and no source.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: A source-selected drug request echoed with a native ID after name resolution.

civic_cursor.description:
CIViC continuation.
Native continuation cursor for that exact drug, profile and claim collection.

civic_kind.description:
CIViC collection.
Independent native evidence or assertion collection within the selected profile.

civic_profile.description:
CIViC profile.
Selected native CIViC molecular profile for a drug-scoped claim stream.

decision_from.description:
From date.
Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD status date; Drugs@FDA approvals.

decision_to.description:
To date.
Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD status date; Drugs@FDA approvals.

document_id.description:
FDA letter document ID.
Exact native Drugs@FDA approval letter document ID. Text is bounded to 25 MiB, 100 pages
and 6144 escaped bytes per fragment. No-text scans are explicit.

evidence_level.description:
A–E
Native CIViC evidence levels; repeat to include several levels.

evidence_status.description:
Status
Native CIViC evidence status; omitted preserves the source's existing default.

label_section.description:
Exact openFDA SPL fields.
Exact published openFDA SPL section fields, including table fields, separated by commas; each is its own part of one reply. Omit it to list names.

partner.description:
Interaction partner.
A DDInter ID or complete drug name, ignoring letter case; DDInter interactions only.
Keeps only the pairs with that drug. A name DDInter does not use is tried under the
names other sources state for it, as the drug itself is.

product_number.description:
FDA product number.
Explicit native application product number, only for approvals.

section.description: Named disclosures of the selected source, each its own part of one reply; empty means identity only.
section.title: Source sections.

section_limit.description:
Named section page size, refused on an identity-only card.
At most 50 rows, or 200 for Drugs@FDA approvals.

section_offset.description: Named section continuation, refused on an identity-only card.

title: DrugGet
